target_universe: 195 sovereign states: 193 UN members plus the Holy See and State of Palestine

rules.missingness: A module is loaded only when at least one numeric observation exists; an empty source row is never treated as coverage.
rules.scope_separation: Harmonised baselines and native national classifications are separate modules.
rules.local_storage: Bulk source snapshots and transforms run in Google Cloud; only compact serving artifacts, contracts and receipts belong in this checkout.

baseline_unemployment.merge_rule: Use the complete IMF country series whenever it has a numeric observation; otherwise use the World Bank country series and retain source, year and status lineage. Never interpolate.

demography.global_source: United Nations World Population Prospects 2024, medium variant
demography.implementation: The registry-driven universal builder uses UN WPP 2024 as the fallback and retains reviewed national and Eurostat projections as preferred overlays; bulk execution runs in Cloud Build.
validation: every target code maps to one UN location
male plus female reconciles to total
all years 2025-2045 aggregate into the four published age bands

health_baseline.source: World Bank World Development Indicators (harmonised WHO and partner series)
health_baseline.implementation: The registry-driven 195-country transformer runs in Cloud Build and publishes an immutable verified serving artifact plus exact per-metric gaps.
validation: retain latest observation year per metric
publish null when no observation exists
do not require OECD-only utilisation metrics for global baseline completeness
